issues.summary: The candidate commander is not self-contained; it requires five faction Mod packages and external campaign data.
issues.impact: A WebUI selection can appear to work while the game silently loads an incomplete Catalog closure.
issues.nextAction: Stage the full closure in Stage 03 and validate the effective DocumentInfo dependency graph before runtime.

issues.summary: Most faction packages are Catalog-heavy and contain no Galaxy source, so static Galaxy lint cannot prove their runtime behavior.
issues.impact: The package may compile statically but still fail to activate units/abilities at runtime.
issues.nextAction: Run an approved launcher smoke path after package staging and inspect same-window ScriptError plus runtime listener evidence.

issues.summary: The final user-facing choice may be one commander with faction presets or multiple commander entries; the source launcher uses five cheat-selected factions.
issues.impact: Incorrect WebUI modeling could expose selections that do not map to a valid effective Mod composition.
issues.nextAction: Freeze the commander/faction preset contract after Stage 03 effective-composition static validation.

issues.summary: No runtime evidence yet proves the source scripted ally roster or the ported AI ally adapter.
issues.impact: Static alliance calls are not proof of correct player ownership, visibility, or cooperative commands in the target runtime.
issues.nextAction: Add simulator and runtime ally checks in Stage 04 and keep them separate from commander package static checks.
